<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most plausible monoisotopic neutral mass is ~193.079 Da (derived from the [M+H]⁺ m/z 194.0862). The formula C₁₀H₁₁NO₃ matches this mass within a few millidaltons and is consistent with the observed ~13 % M+1 intensity (≈10 C atoms). Therefore the molecular formula is C10H11NO3.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H11O3N</final_answer>
